chunks: 1635 - And in another report, from ʿAbdullāh ibn Sinān, he said:
I said to him: “A slave has wealth in his possession; is zakat obligatory upon him?” He said: “No.”
He said: I said, “Then is it upon his master?” So he said: “No, because it has not reached the master, and it does not belong to the slave.”

key_terms.زَكَاةٌ: the obligatory alms-tax due on qualifying wealth
key_terms.لَمْ يَصِلْ: it has not come into the possession of

ai.seo_question: Is zakat due on wealth held in the hand of a slave or on his master?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding wealth held by a mamluk. Zakat is not obligatory on the slave because the wealth is not legally his, and it is not obligatory on the master because the wealth has not yet reached his possession.
